landing.heroSubtitle: Engage every student in real time with dynamic live questions, instant feedback, and zero tracking.
landing.feature1Desc: Engineered for rapid response with oversized touch targets and high-contrast geometric icons.
landing.feature2Desc: No account registration or email required. In-memory session for maximum privacy.
landing.feature3Desc: Dynamic school colors and logos streamed directly from host to student devices.
landing.themePreviewDesc: Preview the signature Pistachio Green and Pumpkin Orange palette adapted to light and dark modes.
landing.faq1Q: Do students need to create an account?
landing.faq1A: No! Students simply enter the 6-digit session PIN and choose a nickname to join instantly.
landing.faq2A: OpenQuiz runs smoothly on any smartphone, tablet, laptop, or desktop modern web browser.
landing.faq3A: Points are calculated using accuracy, response speed, and correct answer streaks.
